Getting used to onshape CAD as a beginner...
This session I learnt how to use the chamfer tool to create 'chamfered' edges lol, the split and mirror tools to copy symmetrical elements, the plane tool to create 'snubs' on corners and the sketch tool to mark points and draw 2d shapes. BTW, my project is designing the driver carriage of a train, specifically the millennium set from sydney trains.

 I had trouble learning how to use this software, which is conveniently a web software, is completely free and is easy to use once you get the hang of it. I had to google a lot and ask my experienced friend how to use this. IMO, it is better to use than sketchup or tinkercad.
